architecture.chain: Guest HTTP -> CommerceConversation -> bounded AgentService -> request-local tools -> PurchaseService -> CommercePort -> independently committed stateful SQL mock
architecture.planner: Replaceable provider planner or deterministic virtual planner; virtual outputs select real tools and SQL results. No paid/real model used by validation.
architecture.explicit_actions: commit_checkout and mock_pay only via server-authored action_ref HTTP from explicit UI, never model tools.
architecture.durability: Purchase/operation/confirmation/action are independent of chat FK; owner+merchant active slot, version CAS, immutable quote/expiry, unique operation generation and stable provider key; unknown/processing never reclaimed to start another transaction.
architecture.recovery: GET queries original external mock receipt; order-timeout recovery does not create payment. Explicit continuation remains necessary. Clearing chat rotates key/epoch but retains purchase.
architecture.ui: schema_version1/mode mock, typed catalog/cart/quote/payment/status/actions. Historical message keeps original UI; newer current state separately displayed. No saved message receipt means no invented feedback ID.
architecture.task_boundary: Every successful explicit shopping turn/action, including replay, fences previous RAG automation state; does not cancel already executed business effects.

limits_of_current_product: Single merchant, CNY, one SKU per cart, quantity1..10, simulated delivery/no real address.
All orders/payments are mock. CommercePort currently rejects real-mode adapters; future real auth/payment integration requires an explicit contract extension.
Virtual natural-language understanding is bounded; explicit SKU/card actions remain the reliable selection path.
SameSite production topology/HTTPS Secure Cookie, real PostgreSQL concurrency/migrations, real supplier/payment authentication and capacity are not accepted by this local evidence.
Legacy message-history read is best effort and can degrade to []; independent purchase recovery does not infer missing purchases from empty chat.
SQLite naive history timestamps can render differently after reload; identified, not fixed in this round.
Action-audit SQL uses JSON predicates, avoiding loading the entire transcript; no JSON index is added, so per-conversation DB scan cost remains.
